manifest.name: Spring Boot
manifest.runtime: Java 25 (Eclipse Temurin 25.0.5 JRE), layered executable jar, no JVM flags
manifest.server: Spring MVC on embedded Tomcat 11 (the starter's default)
manifest.workers: Tomcat's default request thread pool (up to 200 threads); JVM ergonomics for 2 vCPUs and 2 GiB
manifest.database_layer: Spring Data JPA (Hibernate 7.4), HikariCP pool of 16 connections
manifest.logging: none per request (Tomcat's access log is off by default); start-up log at INFO

phase2.validation: @PathVariable int, @RequestParam with @Min/@Max (Spring MVC method validation), @Valid @RequestBody and @Valid @ModelAttribute records (spring-boot-starter-validation): 400

csrf.mechanism: Spring Security CSRF protection (token in the HttpSession, XOR-masked _csrf field added by Thymeleaf's th:action; a garbled token answers 403 instead of 7.1.2's 500)

session.mechanism: Spring Security form login, SecurityContext in Tomcat's in-memory HttpSession
